new_generated_png_candidates.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent species cutout for a reef-aquarium fish catalog and in-scene preview. Subject: one adult blue-green chromis (Chromis viridis), with a slender compressed blue-green body, subtle realistic scale texture, translucent fins, and a clearly forked tail. Composition: clean full-body lateral side profile, entire body and every fin visible with generous transparent padding, fish facing right. Lighting: neutral soft reef light with natural blue-green iridescence and no dramatic color cast. Background: genuinely transparent. Constraints: one fish only; correct chromis anatomy; no coral, water, rocks, sand, ground plane, cast shadow, text, border, logo, or watermark.

notes: For the 11 earlier frozen WebPs, the project docs record generation dates and built-in ImageGen use, but exact prompts and original raw PNG paths are not present in this manifest; do not invent them. The tracked WebPs and hashes identify the delivered canonical files.
The four legacy WebPs were removed only after root approved the v2 static preview replacements; their origin remains unverified and the prior hashes/history are retained for audit.

The four root-approved generated PNG sources are preserved byte-for-byte under docs/asset-evidence/aq66/originals/. Optimized active WebP derivatives are 600 pixels wide, alpha-preserving, and each under 75 KB; the exact derivative hashes, dimensions, and encoder settings are recorded alongside each original.
Every canonical WebP records measured fish-width fraction at alpha > 0.2. Fractions are the horizontal alpha-visible bounding-box width divided by image width, measured from decoded canonical pixels.
The generated source PNGs remain static preview art, not final photorealistic or animated fish assets.
